test_NGOpt_performance: run the test_performance_ngopt parametrized test to benchmark NGOpt against OnePlusOne and CMA optimizers
test_metamodel_special: run the test_metamodel_special parametrized test to benchmark metamodel optimization against CMA and ECMA baselines
create_SimpleFitness: create a SimpleFitness instance with target and factor arrays to evaluate candidate solutions with a quadratic fitness function
review_SimpleFitness_call: review the SimpleFitness call method which computes the sum of weighted cosine squared differences
refactor_test_performance_ngopt: refactor test_performance_ngopt to add new optimizer algorithms or budget multipliers for comparison
